training_data.prompt: Create an asynchronous FastAPI backend service with JWT authentication and Pydantic v2 schemas

completion.code_snippet:
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer
from pydantic import BaseModel, EmailStr
import jwt

app = FastAPI(title='LIA Enterprise API', version='1.0.0')

class UserRegister(BaseModel):
    username: str
    email: EmailStr
    password: str

@app.post('/api/v1/auth/register', status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def register_user(user: UserRegister):
    return {'status': 'success', 'user': user.username}

Write a multi-stage Dockerfile for a Python FastAPI application with UV package manager

completion.dockerfile:
FROM python:3.11-slim as builder
WORKDIR /app
RUN pip install uv
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN uv pip install --system --no-cache -r requirements.txt

FROM python:3.11-slim as runner
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages /usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages
COPY . .
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["python", "run.py"]
